exposure.meaning: Separate fixed follow-up motivated by a post hoc reference diagnostic; does not revise the failed past-market strength family.

input_closure.inherit_source_and_input_hashes_from: inputs.parent_design_lock -> sources and inputs; verify their current bytes and parent verification before execution.
input_closure.reference_extraction: Reuse existing target-free references_selection and references_transfer. Only selection extracts old outcome-control vectors from the verified primary issuance ledger.

metrics.primary: Mean natural-log 1X2 loss over all fixed matched fixtures

adaptations: Neutral new-team entry instead of the paper promotion-rating transfer
Different leagues/years and no international matches
Explicit delayed quote availability and atomic equal-clock updates
Frozen repository ordered-logit constraints and uncertainty gates
paper.parameter_locator: Results / Parameter calibration, paragraph after the introduction of Table 2; Table 2 DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0198668.t002
paper.title: The Betting Odds Rating System: Using soccer forecasts to forecast soccer

quotes.invalid_row_policy: Skip identically for both rating updates and both readout training populations; retain ID/reason.
quotes.normalization: q_i=(1/decimal_odds_i)/sum_j(1/decimal_odds_j), frozen normalized branch; no power method
quotes.valid: Exactly three finite decimal odds greater than one; booleans invalid.

rating.candidate_observed_score: q_home+0.5*q_draw from normalized reciprocal average odds
rating.matched_updates: Both methods use exactly the same quote-valid, strictly available raw fixture IDs at each delay. Result values additionally require resolved A0 before cutoff.
rating.result_observed_score: 1 for H, 0.5 for D, 0 for A, after matched quote-valid temporal admission

readout.failure_policy: Abort with immutable failure receipt; no alternate calibration or settings.
readout.method: Identical inherited ordered-logit objective, solver and parameter constraints
readout.objective: Unweighted mean natural-log outcome loss; no ridge, league indicator or recency weighting
readout.training_rows: Pooled three leagues, quote-valid and resolved by first 2022 selection cutoff; explanatory variables strictly prequential at original issuance.
readout.x: (rating_home-rating_away)/400 at the historical fixture original local-midnight cutoff

selection.frozen_control_availability: Old outcome_control and outcome_control_shot50 remain their saved D+2 vectors under both selection delays; no newly D+8-matched strength fit.
selection.primary_or_sensitivity_failure: Stop later stages; keep all outcomes and the old family failed.

suggested_commit: research(football): specify fixed Elo-Odds transfer follow-up

support.window: [current local league date minus 1095 days, current local league date), intersect strict quote availability

timing.a0: Local midnight after canonical completion day D in each row league timezone.
timing.archive_json_limit: Parent issuance and reference vectors are reused. Underlying original archives contain already exposed outcomes; semantic non-use before the forecast closure is not absence of outcome bytes.
timing.canonical_day: Existing source/completion day, exact-joined to inherited fixture metadata; preserve known Fiorentina-Inter resumption convention.
timing.forecast: The unchanged original forecast_cutoff_utc of each fixture; legacy naive timestamps mean UTC; compare parsed aware datetimes.
timing.numeric_payload_admission: Filter metadata, window and availability before parsing, validating or transforming raw odds or outcome values. Never use current/future fixture odds for any feature, update, scaler, support rule or model.
timing.result_availability: A0 strictly before cutoff; result-Elo is additionally restricted to the same delayed quote-valid membership as market-Elo.
timing.same_time_order: All issuances at the same clock use one common preceding state. Elo updates at equal availability are atomic; events with availability equal to issuance are excluded.
timing.sensitivity_exact_day: D+8 at local00:00, then UTC; not primary+7days and not168elapsedUTC hours

uncertainty.interval: Paired fixed-calendar-block percentile95 using inherited benchmark.paired_uncertainty semantics
